target: Chinese textbook practice including sk7-power and sk7-mixed
releaseRequirement: Confirm the tested site revision contains both new skills; the current public release does not.
privacy: Record anonymous feedback and device/browser details; do not collect children's names or school identifiers.

tasks: Complete six power questions including a negative base and fraction; use the touch minus key and erase a wrong digit.
Complete six mixed-operation questions including parentheses and a wrapped expression.
Return to the home page, complete mistake review and reload; check history and progress.
Test normal sound/animation and reduced animation; observe responsiveness and sound activation.
Switch apps and return during practice and an extra round; record actual timer behavior.
Check portrait/landscape and browser bars for clipping or accidental touches.
sessions.acceptance: Core flows finish without unrecoverable input errors, persistent overlays, clipped controls or lost progress. Record any performance issue with the device and reproduction steps.

tasks: Ask the learner to explain the difference between (-2)^2 and -2^2, and odd/even powers of negative values.
Observe sign input and denominator-then-numerator entry on a fraction answer.
Ask the learner to state operation order before answering mixed questions.
Observe the meaning of a continued expression on the next line.
Ask the learner to erase an incorrect digit, finish practice and find mistake review.
sessions.acceptance: Separate calculation errors from input/reading errors; record every step needing adult help. Successful automated answering does not prove educational effectiveness.

tasks: Complete a carry multiplication practice and a zero-quotient practice.
Observe column-by-column entry, error correction and review.
sessions.acceptance: Record comprehension and interaction issues independently of the new grade-seven features.

tasks: Record a cold load and a warm reload on the same device.
Check failed font/module requests, loading time and the actual release revision.
Complete a short practice and reload; confirm local records remain available.
sessions.acceptance: Report measured loading behavior and failures for each network; use the results to decide whether hosting changes are needed.
